rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an excerpt from a video or an audio recording.

example.english: I've watched this clip many times.
example.traditional: 呢個片段我睇過好多次。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 pin3 dyun6 ngo5 tai2 gwo3 hou2 do1 ci3

rows.note: Use this for a physical clip or clasp that attaches or holds things together.

example.english: I used a clip to hold the documents together.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 gaap3 zi2 gaap3 zyu6 di1 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a clipping cut from a newspaper.

example.english: I still keep this newspaper clip.
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 zin2 bou3 ngo5 zung6 lau4 zyu6
